title: Failureship
tagline: Deliver nothing. Demonstrate everything. Get promoted.

hints.notification: Answer the Notification on the right. Each answer shows what it costs. Nothing else can happen until you do.
hints.dialog: Read what was said, then press Continue to go back to the office.
hints.actions: Click a highlighted place on the floor, or its label, to go there. You have {actions} left. When they are gone, the month closes.
hints.scene: Read the room: who interrupts, who gets looked at, who gets ignored. Then choose how to behave.
hints.notice: Read the result, then press Continue.
hints.move: This has happened to you, and there is nothing to choose. Press Continue to close the month.
hints.story: The month has closed. Replay it to choose differently, or use a different seed to change who really holds influence.
